example.title: Three-storey apartment block with continuous balcony bands
example.place: Santa Monica, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: An early-1970s three-storey apartment block: grey-green stucco with two continuous cantilevered balcony bands across the front, a boxed centre panel, four garage doors below. One photo. Scaled to the lot. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
label: Oceanfront Visitor Ctr.
